title: Truly no one is doing it like Xhloe and Natasha right now, and if you...
transcript: If you have not been following the insane rise of Xhloe and Natasha, now is absolutely the time to hop on board. They have been Edinburgh Fringe darlings, winning the Fringe First Award three years in a row. They performed in London, New York, all across the world. And now they have their first full scale production of And The Rodeo Burn Down playing in New York. And I think this was a great choice to be their first full scale production because of their three plays that have played Endinburgh Fringe, while all really solid, this one might just be my favorite. It tells the story of Dale, a Rodeo clown who desperately wants to be a cowboy, and along the way kind of becomes this meta commentary on aspiration and what it means to be an artist. The entire theatre has been transformed into a Rodeo barn and it's cool to see what they're able to do with a budget. While the upgraded set and lighting is certainly appreciated and well executed, the key ingredient continues to be the writing and chemistry of Xhloe and Natasha. The writing is witty and cerebral. You never really quite know where it's gonna go next. And together they are just so in sync. Every movement is so precise and perfectly complimented by the other. It's this constant Yin and Yang, push and pull that's just so mesmerizing to watch. And this show is, I think, a perfect showcase for all of their strengths. So if You've never seen a Xhloe and Natasha show. This one is a great introduction. I really think that they are geniuses at what they do and destined to become the next big thing in the off Broadway indie theatre scene if they aren't already. And the Rodeo burned down is definitely going to be a Broadway Ben must see.
